fixes.portable_boundary: Python 3.12 may omit these aliases and _DeprecatedType; absence is not fabricated as a qualified alias. Lookalikes remain unresolved.

fixes.rca: The old receipt retained only <string>/<frozen runpy>, losing actual code/factory lineage. Its 112 raw executions cannot be retroactively attributed or split.
fixes.fix: For rare opaque exec only, inspect the actual CodeType and one caller frame. collections.namedtuple/dataclasses._create_fn require their actual registered function code, real parent globals, compiler references from exact stdlib source, exact eval/exec callsite and compiled bounded generation input. Frozen execution requires exact actual interpreter frozen-code comparison. Unknown opaque execution remains UNVERIFIED.
fixes.bounds: Strong code references and JSON metadata share the unchanged 2048 admission budget. Generated text is at most 4096 characters and UTF-8 bytes. Code/source fingerprints are computed only for a unique qualified rare code object; no file reads or per-function profiling in the callback.
fixes.unsupported: Other runtime factories are not generically allowed; missing source/code/callsite evidence remains fail-closed.

fixes.rca: filename=None plus final absence did not distinguish actual optional failure from executed-and-deleted modules. Cython registry objects lacked a recorded parent factory.
fixes.fix: Opt-in observation delegates the exact original frozen import machinery results and BaseException unchanged. Bounded deduplicated actual attempt outcomes join selected real loaders to audit import/exec events. Only actual ModuleNotFoundError with matching name, before any selected loader, and a verified real core-importer traceback raiser qualifies failed lookup. This rare exceptional check is capped at eight traceback frames, without tracing or sampling; user-finder constructed errors cannot merge into a genuine result for the same name. Executed transient modules retain their actual file events and outcome. The two observed charset_normalizer extension factories require actual ExtensionFileLoader/method identities, parent module/spec/loader/file attributes, uncontended registry object creation and actual Cython parent type references or the exact cython_runtime shape.
fixes.creation_scope: Observed registry object creation inside an uncontended original extension load is local factory provenance, not C-extension binary authentication or proof of every native instruction. Earlier, replaced, unknown or ambiguous synthetic objects remain unresolved.
fixes.restore: Each observer detaches on every exit. Shared import machinery is restored only when no owner remains and the installed callable is still the owned dispatcher. Live protocol calls at the final boundary prevent closure; later callbacks cannot make the closed receipt GREEN.

audit_hook_installation.finding: Python may suppress a RuntimeError veto of sys.addaudithook, so a successful return alone does not prove installation.
audit_hook_installation.fix: Before business activation, emit one private audit sentinel with this observer's exact object nonce. Require exactly one reception during installation, preserve raised exceptions, and deactivate/restore import machinery on zero/duplicate/error. INITIAL and FINAL retain exact installation status. The sentinel is excluded from import/exec counters and evidence-record admission.

foreign_class_metadata.finding: type.__getattribute__ bypasses a metaclass method override but can still execute a descriptor supplied by that foreign metaclass.
foreign_class_metadata.fix: Read physical class fields by directly invoking the original built-in type descriptors, and ImportError.name via its original member descriptor. Non-string/unbounded metadata is unverified. Do not call foreign metaclass descriptors merely to label the loader, exception or referenced native type.
